deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's flow
Independent third-party smart-contract security audit with remediation published
Public launch campaign and trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
Revenue-share repayment mechanism to reimburse the Treasury
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. and Intersect as budget administrator; Sellout is the operating partner/client.
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification, funded by Sellout with over $130,000 of its own capital.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, inclusive of a 3% Intersect administration fee, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursement.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and a professional launch campaign.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and currently runs 350+ events annually.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 deployment is contracted and is projected to move more than $6 million through Cardano in year one, based on $5.88 million in 2025 historical activity.
The proposers commit to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of all fees until full reimbursement and 5% thereafter.

The proposal includes treasury protections such as milestone gating, contingency return, undisbursed funds remaining under Treasury control, independent audit and oversight review, public quarterly reporting, and contractual revenue-share repayment.
Anvil reports a track record of 250+ Cardano projects delivered, 456,000+ assets minted, 50,000,000+ ADA staked through Anvil infrastructure, and 267,000+ on-chain transactions.
The proposal states all on-chain metrics will be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data and policy-ID tracking, with a public metrics dashboard delivered in milestone M5.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with milestone-gated disbursement, Intersect administration, claimed existing Sellout adoption, projected on-chain ticketing activity, and a proposed revenue-share repayment to the Treasury.
